response.sql:
WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS "count"
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM("count") AS total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_types
  FROM counts_by_type
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cbt.tradekind,
    cbt."count",
    CAST(cbt."count" AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share,
    1.0 / CAST(t.num_types AS REAL) AS avg_share
  FROM counts_by_type cbt
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  "count",
  share,
  share - avg_share
FROM with_metrics
WHERE avg_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > avg_share
ORDER BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: "Exact text matches and dropping anything that doesn't match" means INNER JOINs on all three relationships (advancedbehavior→transactionrecord, transactionrecord→trader), keeping only rows where foreign keys match referenced primary keys.
"The plain average of the per-type shares" refers to the arithmetic mean of all per-type share values, which equals 1 ÷ (number of types) by definition.
NULL values in tradekind are treated as a distinct group (the default GROUP BY behavior in SQL), not filtered out.
